existing.label: Existing 1985 glazing
existing.note: Fixed double glazing, U 2.8. No cost, no carbon, and no way to open a window.

upgraded.label: New openable triple glazing
upgraded.note: Same openings, U 0.9, openable sashes for purge ventilation.

lowered.label: Triple glazing, sill lowered to 600
lowered.note: Adds a seated view and daylight; costs a cut spandrel.

products.mixed: Durable beds and desks, second-hand the rest

brief.label: Senior / elderly housing
brief.notes: Rollator users need 1500 mm turning; a care resident with a hoist needs 1800 mm and 900 mm working space at the bed.
